title: Analysis of Delay Differential Equations Using the Offset Linear Canonical Transform
summary: Motivated by the work of Ohira and the advantages of the offset linear canonical transform (OLCT) over the Fourier transform (FT), this paper proposes an OLCT based framework for solving a class of delay differential equations. By exploiting the operational properties of the OLCT, the original delay differ- ential equation is transformed into a Volterra-type delay integral equation in the transform domain and solved numerically using Brunners method of steps .
